payload.content: A read-only WordPress media-audit plugin helping administrators find where images are used across featured media and supported ACF fields before replacing or deleting files.
payload.description_1: Image Usage Scanner solves a WordPress maintenance question that is deceptively difficult: where is a media item being used? Images can appear as featured media, in normal content or inside supported ACF fields, so deleting or replacing a file based on one screen can break references elsewhere.
payload.description_2: I shaped Image Usage Scanner as an admin-only audit workflow that reports media relationships instead of modifying them. It checks featured images and supported ACF image or gallery fields in bounded batches, saving progress so a scan can continue after interruption.
